_meta.description: D6 fixtures for strands / interrupt-headless. The tool call these fixtures emit reaches a backend tool that pauses on Strands' native interrupt, so the bridge translates it into an AG-UI interrupt outcome. The tool takes only topic and attendee: candidate slots are generated by the frontend.
